title_zh: 出埃及 · 旷野行程 · 手绘纸稿
guide_one_liner: 从埃及苦役起行，经红海、玛拉、以琳、利非订，直到西奈山下安营；以羊皮纸墨线小景呈现，总览交给 SVG 示意图。
era_geo: Late Bronze Age Egypt and Sinai wilderness; mudbrick store cities, Reed Sea shore, desert oasis palms, rocky wadis, Mount Sinai massif; Israelite traveler cloaks, staffs, tents — no modern objects
overview_note: path overview uses SVG schematic; no bitmap prompt
